request.spec:
A person may name other people on the sheet as their patrons, one at a time from their row (not
themselves, and not the same person twice; a refusal shows an error on the row; PATRON_ADDED
name=<name> patron=<patron name>). Show each person's patrons (names, comma and space separated,
sorted) and their backing: their patrons' due-totals added up, skipping n/a, 0.00 with no
patrons.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A person may name other people on the sheet as their patrons, one at a time from their row (not
themselves, and not the same person twice; a refusal shows an error on the row; PATRON_ADDED
name=<name> patron=<patron name>). Show each person's patrons (names, comma and space separated,
sorted) and their backing: their patrons' due-totals added up, skipping n/a, 0.00 with no

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Patrons and backing are in, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**What a user can do**
- Each person's row has a dropdown listing everyone else on the sheet and an "Add patron" button. People can't pick themselves: their own name isn't in the list, and the server would refuse it anyway.
- Adding a patron twice, or adding someone who isn't on the sheet, is refused. The row shows `person-patron-error` and nothing is saved or audited. The error clears on the row's next action or when the dropdown changes.
- When a patron is added, the audit file gets `PATRON_ADDED sheet=<id> by=<user> name=<name> patron=<patron name>`.

**What the row shows**
- `person-patrons`: the patrons' names, sorted and separated by ", ".
- `person-backing`: the patrons' due-totals as their own rows show them, added up and skipping n/a. It's 0.00 with no patrons. Because it reuses the due-total calculation, it follows holds, statements and the like; for example, putting a patron on hold lowers the backing of everyone they back.

**How it's stored**
- A new table, `V19__person_patron.sql`, records one row per person–patron pair. The database itself blocks a person being their own patron or the same pair being added twice.
- A new endpoint, `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/people/{personId}/patrons`, adds a patron.
- The person data the app loads now carries `patronIds`. The screen looks up the names from those ids, so a renamed patron shows under their new name.

The front-end changes are in `features/people/People.tsx` and `features/people/api.ts`.
